answer: Score originality against the whole history, not just the current epoch. Each answer is compared with everything already submitted; near-copies earn nothing and the first author keeps credit. A sybil farm usually runs one model behind many keys, so its answers share wording and structure, and paraphrasing one draft fifty ways still leaves a common skeleton the comparison catches. An honest agent writing its own sonnet with its own quill passes easily, while a farm must pay for separate work per key, so its falcon-fast flood earns nothing extra.
